Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the standard for daily service at Aurelia Skyways and keeps animal travel handling orderly, safe, and consistent. Staff must place animal welfare first, confirm the booking details against the ledger, and review each care plan for species, temperament, and comfort before any service change is approved. The senior coordinator oversees these decisions and gives final direction when a case is unclear or a cabin arrangement must be adjusted.

Staff must speak plainly with travelers, note every service change in the desk ledger, and keep records complete and current. If an animal shows stress, if a crate is unsuitable, or if a comfort item is missing, the matter moves at once to the senior coordinator. Speed never outweighs safety, and no desk action is complete until the record matches the service provided.

When a traveler arrives with a pet, staff must check the animal calmly, protect privacy, and keep the desk area orderly. Companion Animal Travel Desk staff are expected to maintain steady judgment, careful notes, and respectful service at all times.

Contact the senior coordinator for any unresolved travel issue.
